title: Fine-grained Approaches for Confidence Calibration of LLMs in Automated Code Revision
abstract: arXiv:2604.06723v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In today's AI-assisted software engineering landscape, developers increasingly depend on LLMs that are highly capable, yet inherently imperfect. The tendency of these models to produce incorrect outputs can reduce developer productivity. To this end, a canonical mitigation method is to provide calibrated confidence scores that faithfully reflect their likelihood of correctness at the instance-level. Such information allows users to make immediate decisions regarding output acceptance, abstain error-prone outputs, and better align their expectations with the model's capabilities. translated_title: 自动代码修订中大语言模型置信度校准的细粒度方法
translated_abstract: 在当今AI辅助软件工程的背景下，开发者越来越依赖能力强大但本质上并不完美的大语言模型（LLM）。这些模型产生错误输出的倾向会降低开发者的生产力。为此，一种经典的缓解方法是提供经过校准的置信度分数，在实例层面真实地反映其输出的正确可能性。这类信息使用户能够立即对输出做出接受与否的决策、放弃易出错的输出，并更好地使其期望与模型能力保持一致。由于经过后训练的LLM本身不会产生良好校准的置信度分数，研究人员开发了事后校准方法，其中对序列级置信度分数进行全局Platt缩放（Platt-scaling）的方法在许多生成式软件工程任务中被证明是有效的，但在自动代码修订（ACR）等任务中仍然不可靠或尚未被探索……
tldr: 该论文针对自动代码修订（ACR）任务，提出细粒度的LLM置信度校准方法，以解决传统全局Platt缩放方法在此类任务中不可靠的问题，从而帮助开发者更好地判断模型输出的可信度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes fine-grained confidence calibration approaches for LLMs in automated code revision (ACR) tasks, addressing the unreliability of traditional global Platt-scaling methods and enabling developers to better assess the trustworthiness of model outputs.
